ontology.name: FIBO Loan Classification
ontology.description: Loan types with Basel risk weights, collateral categories, and OCC/FDIC concentration buckets. Adapted from EDM Council FIBO. Source: https://github.com/edmcouncil/fibo — MIT License.

entityTypes.name: ConcentrationCategory

entityTypes.name: LoanType
entityTypes.description: Loan product classification with Basel III risk weight, regulatory treatment, and capital tier.

entityTypes.name: CollateralType
entityTypes.description: Collateral asset category with recovery expectations and concentration classification.

relationships.name: typicallySecuredBy
relationships.description: Links a collateral type to the loan types it typically secures.
